title: Ocampo Street Closed for 10 Days in Nuevo Laredo — Here's the Detour
excerpt: COMAPA closed Calle Ocampo between Belden and Nicolás Bravo starting Monday for sewer collector repairs. The work is expected to last 10 days.
content:
Drivers in Nuevo Laredo will need a new route this week. The city's water and sewer utility, COMAPA, closed a stretch of Calle Ocampo to vehicle traffic starting Monday, October 19, 2026, for rehabilitation work on the Colector Ribereño Centro — and the closure is expected to last about 10 days.

Where and how long

The closed segment runs on Calle Ocampo between Belden and Nicolás Bravo. COMAPA is asking drivers to plan ahead, respect the posted detour signs, and drive with caution through the work zone while crews are on site.

The detour

Motorists heading toward the SENTRI lane access can use Matamoros and Nicolás Bravo streets to continue their route, according to the utility. Anyone crossing the border in the coming days should build in extra time — a 10-day closure on a SENTRI feeder route is the kind of thing that turns a quick crossing into a long one.

Webb Watch 956 will keep an eye on whether the work finishes on schedule.
